title: StubHub Promise Fulfilled After Seller Backed Out of World Cup Tickets
text:
Sanjay Kalra and his family purchased FIFA World Cup tickets through StubHub for a match in the Bay Area. The seller backed out just before the game, leaving them with no tickets and sky-high prices. After complaints to agencies and 7 On Your Side, StubHub provided replacement tickets, citing event ticketing infrastructure issues.
We all know FIFA World Cup tickets are a hot commodity. Especially when Team USA is playing in the Bay Area! This one is relatable for anyone who's purchased highly sought after tickets on StubHub.
You plan months in advance, invest thousands of dollars, and then comes the utter disappointment: Oops, the seller backed out. Sanjay Kalra and his family are huge FIFA fans -- and couldn't wait to attend their first game in the Bay Area. So much so, he bought tickets back in November. He says he was told from the seller he would receive the tickets a few days before the game.
World Cup 2026: Everything to know about games at Levi's Stadium, Bay Area watch parties and more But that excitement quickly shifted, the day the United States qualified for the game. StubHub told him, they're actually not going to get the tickets because "the seller backed out.
""By that time - ticket prices had jumped 10 times - so even if I get the money back there's no way I can afford to buy replacement tickets," Kalra said. Sanjay tried reporting his experience to four state and federal agencies - including the state attorney general's office with no luck, until he reached out to 7 On Your Side. And the next day, StubHub called him back, reversing course, confirming replacement tickets.
StubHub issued a statement to 7 On Your Side writing: "The issues fans have experienced at this World Cup are largely transfer problems, not ticket problems. The event organizer's own ticketing infrastructure, including a new app launched right before the tournament began, has had significant performance issues that have affected transfers across all resale platforms. We've responded by standing up a dedicated world cup support team and expanding our capacity to source replacement tickets for affected customers.
Every order is backed by our fanprotect guarantee, and getting fans to their matches remains our top priority for the REST of this tournament.
" "I was really excited," Kalra said. "Luckily for me and people like you, I get to go to the game with my kids! " Bottom line, if a seller can't deliver the tickets they sold - like in this case, they back out, or can't transfer them, StubHub's "Fanprotect guarantee" policy states -it will try to provide comparable or better replacement tickets.
But, replacement tickets are not guaranteed.7OYS's consumer hotline is a free consumer mediation service for those in the San Francisco Bay Area.
